gloss: under renovation; being remodeled; closed for refurbishment

definitions.gloss: under renovation; being remodeled; closed for refurbishment
definitions.explanation: a state where a building, store, or facility is currently being renovated or remodeled

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{改装中|かいそうちゅう}です。
{改装中|かいそうちゅう}のため、しばらく{休業|きゅうぎょう}します。
examples.english: We will be temporarily closed for renovation.

examples.japanese: お{気|き}に{入|い}りのレストランが{改装中|かいそうちゅう}で、リニューアルオープンを{楽|たの}しみにしている。
examples.english: My favorite restaurant is under renovation, and I'm looking forward to its reopening.

notes:
Composed of {改装|かいそう} (renovation/remodeling) and {中|ちゅう} (during/in the middle of). A very common sign and announcement seen on storefronts and buildings in Japan. The suffix {中|ちゅう} is productive and attaches to many nouns to indicate an ongoing activity ({工事中|こうじちゅう}, {準備中|じゅんびちゅう}, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改装中|かいそうちゅう}のため{休業|きゅうぎょう}: closed for renovation
- {改装中|かいそうちゅう}の{店舗|てんぽ}: store under renovation
- {只今|ただいま}{改装中|かいそうちゅう}: currently under renovation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {工事中|こうじちゅう}: under construction — for building or infrastructure work, not just interior remodeling
- {準備中|じゅんびちゅう}: in preparation — used when a shop is getting ready to open for the day
- {休業中|きゅうぎょうちゅう}: temporarily closed — closed for any reason, not necessarily renovation
